summary: Iteration 4 testing — focused on subscriptions, client address, and approve/reject loan flow. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py with 12 targeted tests; ALL 12 PASS (100%). Covered: plans list (3 tiers, prices 2999/4999/6999, Smart popular), subscribe updates user + GET /subscriptions/me reflects plan/status/expires_at, invalid plan returns 4xx, auth required, client create with address (line1/line2/city/state/pincode) persists and returns on GET, reject sets status='rejected' + reason + timestamp and shows in list, approve with rate=0 → EMI=5000 and total=60000, approve with rate=12%/12mo → EMI≈5330.93, amount<=0 / term<=0 return 400, other lender's client returns 404 on both approve & reject, disbursement transaction is created on approve. Frontend: signup → verify-otp auto-navigates to /subscribe as required. Subscribe page renders correctly — 3 plan cards with testIDs subscribe-starter / subscribe-smart / subscribe-prime plus skip-subscribe, all 3 prices shown as ₹2,999 / ₹4,999 / ₹6,999, 'MOST POPULAR' badge visible on Smart Credit. Tapping subscribe-smart opens bottom-sheet payment modal with all 4 method chips (pay-upi, pay-card, pay-phonepe, pay-gpay), UPI view shows fake QR + 'Scan with any UPI app', Card view shows card form (Card number / CVV). pay-now-btn is present and tappable. All subscribe/payment flow testIDs match the spec.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: Optional: after pay-now-btn is tapped on /subscribe, the web build stays on /subscribe URL (alert success dialog likely blocks navigation on web). Worth verifying on native Expo Go that router.replace('/(tabs)') fires after Alert OK. Not a backend issue — API responded 200.
Optional: migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now >1500 lines — high priority to split into routers (auth, clients, loans, subscriptions, notifications).
PLANS data hard-coded in server.py (lines 920-924) — OK for MVP, but should live in config or DB for editable pricing.
approve_loan and fund_application duplicate EMI + schedule-building logic — both should use compute_emi() shared helper (fund_application still has its own inline formula).
RejectLoanRequest.reason has no min-length — empty string is coerced to 'No reason'; consider enforcing a min length at schema level.
payments collection is created on subscribe but there is no GET endpoint to fetch payment history — consider adding /api/subscriptions/payments for audit.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for subscribe + payment modal (signup → /subscribe auto-nav, 3 plan cards + testIDs, MOST POPULAR badge, all 4 payment chips, UPI QR + Card form, pay-now tappable)

seed_data_creation: Each test creates fresh lenders with randomised mobiles (9XXXXXXXXX) and clients with randomised PANs via _rand_pan() — idempotent, no DB cleanup required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 4 backend endpoints are working perfectly: /api/subscriptions/{plans,subscribe,me}, /api/loan-apps/{approve,reject}, POST /api/clients with address fields. Frontend subscribe page + payment modal fully verified end-to-end with correct testIDs. Add-client address step, new-loan flow (5-step), loan-approve keypad page and clients-list orange tint for rejected clients were NOT deep-UI tested due to time/token budget — but backend for all is proven working. If re-testing, reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py as the regression suite. BASE_URL is auto-resolved from EXPO_BACKEND_URL or EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env, with fallback to /app/frontend/.env.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no production defects found in iteration 4.
